reasoning_content:
config.json is imported/bundled, not fetched at runtime, so 404 is fine. Let me verify the production build serves via a static server, and check the bundle contains the map config data. Also verify the app's JS executes — ideally check whether it uses maplibre and config is bundled in bundle.js.

Let me serve dist statically with python http.server and curl.

action.command: cd /workspace/dist && (nohup python3 -m http.server 9090 > /tmp/qm_static.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && for p in / /bundle.js /vendor/maplibre/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs /oss-licenses.json; do printf "%-45s " "$p"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" "http://localhost:9090$p"; done && echo "---title---" && curl -s http://localhost:9090/ | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" && echo "---bundle markers---" && grep -c "maplibre" bundle.js && grep -o "NRW Luftbild Farbe" bundle.js | head -1
